reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: `liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens` is called at line 750 (non-test caller, not dead code). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attack entry point is an untrusted external liquidator. Gate 3: `contracts/protocol/sources/internal/market/market.move` is explicitly in scope and liquidation logic is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidation entry point by submitting a liquidation during a collateral price crash (spot < EMA), causing the seize calculation to use the lower spot price for collateral while eligibility was checked at EMA, yielding proportionally more seized cTokens per unit of debt repaid than the protocol intends and extracting the price-divergence delta at the borrower's expense.
